# FR3D Placeholder

The current lab package may be placed as `external/fr3d/fr3d-python-latest/`; the fixed config points there. Its checkout must contain `fr3d/__init__.py` and `fr3d/search/FR3D.py`.

Alternatively, place the checkout contents directly in `external/fr3d/` and update `config/fr3d_config.json` accordingly.

FR3D itself is intentionally not distributed with RSMViewer.
